_comment: Park run-environment factors keyed by MLB venue_id. 1.0 = neutral. Coors Field (id 19) is set to 1.12 (well-documented altitude effect); all others are 1.0 placeholders pending a real derivation from 3 seasons of game-level runs-by-venue (Phase 4+ task). venue_ids are 2026 team home venues; spring-training and neutral-site venues are excluded.
